title: H3 Director · lot exemple · 2 scenes
intro: Exemple : deux scenes, chacune avec son propre casting.
style_line: Footage from a VHS tape recorded at home in 1987: a French television documentary ... Handheld at shoulder height from one spot at a time ... The camera only pans and tilts. Mostly medium shots and close-ups, full figures only briefly. ... Deadpan slice of life, slow, long silences, no punchline. Every face is real human skin with visible pores, fine lines and small imperfections, moving naturally.
overall_soundscape: mono camcorder sound with a constant tape hiss: the room tone of each place, footsteps, voices too low to understand; no music

m091.description: a puffy-faced man of about forty with curly blond hair, in a dark red velvet waistcoat with huge pink feather sleeves

m436.description: a narrow-faced man of about fifty with slicked-back black hair, in an immense shaggy white fur coat

m609.description: a long-faced man of about fifty-five with a thin moustache, a pointed silver helmet and a shiny silver jumpsuit

decor_poste.description: a small French post office in 1987, the counter on the right, the queue on the left: the set of every shot

cuts.text: The counter with its glass screen on the right, the queue on the left. Camera A, from the end of the queue: <Subject 1> stands at the counter, his pink feather sleeves spilling over the ledge.
Camera A, medium shot: the clerk, a woman with a grey perm, weighs his envelope on the scale.
Close-up of <Subject 1>: he lifts his chin and holds a long pout at her through the glass.
Close-up of the clerk: she slides a stamp under the glass very slowly.
Camera A: in the queue a man in a cap shifts his parcel and stares at the feathers.
Close-up of <Subject 1>: he presses the stamp on and stays at the counter, his eyes on the clerk.

A checkout of a French supermarket in 1987, the belt on the right, the queue on the left. Camera A, from the next till: <Subject 1> stands at the belt in his white fur coat; <Subject 2> waits behind him in his silver suit.
Camera A, medium shot: the cashier types the price and looks up at the fur.
Close-up of <Subject 1>: he counts out coins one by one, chin high, staring at her.
Close-up of <Subject 2>: he pivots on his heel and holds a pout at the queue.
Close-up of the cashier: she pushes the coins into her palm and looks at the queue.
Camera A: the two stay at the end of the belt; the next customer waits with her trolley.
